title: Explain hidden portfolio concentration
purpose: For developers extending a trading application, trace indirect economic exposure and verify identical business answers before comparing storage implementations.
entryAssumptions: Understand C2 accounts, positions, pricing and asynchronous trade booking.
concepts: A fund holding is a weighted economic allocation. Corporate-parent links group issuers. Separate allocation paths contribute separately to exposure.
runtimePrerequisites: Docker Compose and the state quickstart prerequisites. Use one runtime at a time and disposable test databases.

transitions.carriesForward: Keep transactional positions and the C2 trading workflow.
transitions.motivation: Direct holdings hide concentration through funds and related issuers.
transitions.increment: Add weighted look-through traversal with visible evidence and source freshness.
transitions.evidence: Known synthetic portfolio shows 2% direct and 12% indirect exposure; both engines must agree after source edits.

after: Corporate exposure includes nested funds and issuer groups, with contributing paths.

objectives.outcome: Reconcile the 14% portfolio exposure with its direct and indirect allocations.
Compare source revisions and verify changed positions before interpreting latency results.

walkthrough.action: Start this state and open /exposure/. Select account 70000 and target Z0G; expand and reconcile both paths.
walkthrough.expected: 2% direct plus 12% through funds equals 14%, at fixed USD snapshot marks.

walkthrough.action: Change the Z0S quantity from 20 to 40 using the quickstart SQL workflow, wait for a new revision, and calculate again. Restore the quantity after recording the result.
walkthrough.expected: Exposure changes to 16000/102000; both implementations agree. A changed valuation timestamp must not be inferred from a position-only edit.

assessments.question: Why does doubling the direct position change the portfolio denominator as well as its target exposure?
assessments.guidance: Compute the changed portfolio value and contributions separately, and compare identical source revisions before comparing database latency.

limitations: Current-snapshot long-only USD demo with fixed marks; no historical as-of queries or derivative valuation.
Full snapshot rebuild is a demonstrable reconciliation strategy, not a production CDC or multi-replica design.

coaching.diagnosticQuestion: Which allocation weights multiply along a fund path?
coaching.predictionPrompt: Predict total exposure after increasing Z0S quantity from 20 to 40.
hints: Start with the $100,000 portfolio and $14,000 exposure.
The extra 20 units add $2,000 to both values.
coaching.misconception: Doubling one holding doubles the entire exposure percentage.
coaching.evidenceToRequest: Show the source position, projection revision, total portfolio value and contributing paths.
